name: MoFA Nepal
text: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood (29 August 2026). So far, 626 bodies recovered; about 2400 people still unaccounted for; over 4450 people rescued including over 187 foreign nationals. Search and verification continue — figures may change. Full briefing: mofa.gov.np

name: MoFA Nepal
text: Latest Updates on Flash Floods — 28 August 2026. Flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River area on 26 August. So far, 538 bodies recovered; 632 people from 33 countries — 121 found, 511 missing. Search and rescue continues. MoFA Emergency Control Room: +977-9744441227 / +977-9744441228, emergency@mofa.gov.np

name: MoFA Nepal
text: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for foreign nationals affected by the Bhote Koshi flash flood in Rasuwa. Hotline/WhatsApp +977-9744441227 and +977-9744441228 (7am–10pm). Email: emergency@mofa.gov.np. Updates: mofa.gov.np/category/flashflood/

name: MEA India
text: Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation. Families of Indian nationals may contact: +91-11-23088718, +91-11-23088719, WhatsApp +91-9968291988, email situationroom@mea.gov.in

name: Embassy of India Beijing
text: Following the recent flash floods and mudslides in the Tibet Autonomous Region (TAR), People’s Republic of China, TAR authorities have established two dedicated 24-hour English-language hotlines to assist families seeking information about missing foreign nationals. The hotlines can be reached at: 1) 0086-891-6817165 2) 0086-183-0802-6705 @MEAIndia

name: NDRRMA Nepal
text: आज मिति २०८३।०५।१३ गते उद्वार गरिएको पुरुषहरुको विवरण — details of men rescued today (13 Bhadra 2083 / 29 Aug 2026).

name: NDRRMA Nepal
text: विपद् उद्धार गरी उपचार्थ काठमाडौं ल्याइएको घाइतेहरूको उपचार भइरहेको अस्पतालहरूको विवरण — details of hospitals in Kathmandu treating people injured in the disaster and brought for treatment. @moha_nepal

name: NDRRMA Nepal
text: रसुवा भोटेकोशी/त्रिशुली बाढीबाट घाइतेहरुमध्ये काठमाडौंका विभिन्न अस्पतालमा हाल उपचाररत र उपचार पश्चात डिश्चार्ज भएका व्यक्तिहरुको विवरण। हाल उपचाररत: https://ndrrma.gov.np/np/notice-information — उपचार पश्चात डिश्चार्ज: https://ndrrma.gov.np/np/misc-report

name: NDRRMA Nepal
text: भोटेकोशी बाढीसम्बन्धी खोज, उद्धार तथा राहत अपडेट-२०८३, (मितिः२०८३ भदौ १४ गते बिहान ९ बजेसम्म प्राप्त जानकारीसहित) — Bhotekoshi flood search, rescue and relief update as of 9am on 14 Bhadra 2083 (30 Aug 2026).

name: NDRRMA Nepal
text: List of foreign Citizens Rescued Today (August 29, 2026). See the post for the attached list / details.

name: NDRRMA Nepal
text: Rescue and coordination updates for the Bhotekoshi / Rasuwa flash flood are published on the NDRRMA rescue portal and SETU platform. Families should use official channels — ndrrma.gov.np/np/rescue and setu.ndrrma.gov.np

name: Nepal Police HQ
text: Nepal Police Unified Database (UDB) publishes official found, missing, and unidentified remains lists for the flood-affected areas. Search at udb.nepalpolice.gov.np — do not rely on unofficial social media posts.

name: Embassy of India Kathmandu
text: Embassy of India, Kathmandu is coordinating with Nepalese authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals affected by flash floods in Rasuwa / Bhotekoshi area. Contact MEA control room or Embassy for assistance.

name: Parshuram Kaphle
text: Nepali journalist on the Rasuwa / Bhote Koshi flash flood: questions early-warning gaps from across the northern border after devastating flooding. Not an official statement — verify with MoFA / NDRRMA.

name: The Kathmandu Post
text: Ground report: more than 1,000 relatives arrived in Pokhara to view photos of 102 bodies recovered downstream after the Bhotekoshi flood (Gorkha, Tanahun, Dhading, Nawalparasi East). Help desk offers free support for filing reports and transport. Journalistic coverage — confirm with police / NDRRMA.

name: The Kathmandu Post
text: Bodies from Rasuwa / Nuwakot turning up far downstream; Chitwan and Pokhara morgues under strain. Temporary body-management centres and relatives searching for missing family. Not an official list — verify with district police / NDRRMA.

name: The Kathmandu Post
text: From Nuwakot’s flooded villages: relief slow to reach some settlements; search for buried homes and missing relatives continuing days after the Bhotekoshi surge. Open original for names and local detail.

name: The Rising Nepal
text: Gorkhapatra / Rising Nepal ground reporting from Dhunge Bazaar to Trishuli and Devighat — minutes to evacuate after DAO Rasuwa alerted NDRRMA ~8:55am; journalists documenting rescue alongside security forces.

name: NDTV
text: NDTV ground report from Rasuwa with Sikta Deo and Ranveer Singh — debris, washed-out markets, glacier/debris-flow scene along Bhotekoshi–Trishuli. Confirm casualty figures with NDRRMA.

name: The Hindu
text: Live coverage: death toll and missing figures rising; NDRRMA warned Bhotekoshi water levels rose again Sunday morning; tunnel rescues continue. Numbers move fast — check MoFA / NDRRMA originals.
